acceptance_criteria: Modifies ngv2/conductor_seams.py by extending the nested build_evidence closure inside build_default_seams.
Uses a single kind:symbol patch on build_default_seams.
Derives ev['findings'] from state['prior_findings'] when findings is not in ev and prior_findings is non-empty.
Omits findings from ev entirely when prior_findings is empty or absent.

spec.objective: Extend build_evidence nested closure in ngv2/conductor_seams.py to derive evidence['findings'] from state['prior_findings'].
functional_requirements: Derive ev['findings'] from state['prior_findings'] when findings not in ev.
Omit the findings key entirely from ev when state['prior_findings'] is empty or absent (never set to None or []).
Ensure no other evidence key, closure, or gate executor logic changes.
spec.interfaces: Internal nested closure build_evidence within build_default_seams in ngv2/conductor_seams.py.
edge_cases: State has no prior_findings, ev['findings'] must be omitted.
State has non-empty prior_findings, ev['findings'] must contain the list of findings.
non_goals: Do not touch ngv2/gate_executor.py (integration is out of scope).
Do not touch transition_planner, hunt_conductor, or any other files.
spec.implementation_notes:
Patch build_default_seams using __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ kind:symbol replacing the enclosing function and adding findings derivation block to build_evidence.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

spec.objective: Author a new test file tests/ngv2/test_p11_hunt_triage_findings.py that verifies the hunt->triage transition is correctly gated by evidence['findings'] derived from state['prior_findings'].
functional_requirements: Verify build_evidence derives findings key from state['prior_findings'] containing a unique sentinel token.
Verify run_gates('hunt', 'triage', ev) advances when findings evidence is present.
Verify run_conductor_step advances session phase from hunt to triage.
Verify end-to-end traversal of FSM from phase hunt progresses past hunt to at least triage when composed with other phase rollups.

Sentinel token is present in the derived findings, proving it was not a pre-injected literal.
non_goals: Integration tests using real workers, live environment, clock, subprocess, network, or sleeps are out of scope (integration is out of scope).
spec.implementation_notes: Implement tests driving the real conductor, using FakeDB to hold state, and feeding realistic hunt report rollups with unique sentinel tokens. Verify correct derivation of findings key and successful transition.
